hints.title: Symmetric Length 5 Decomposition
hints.text: A length-5 palindromic subsequence has pattern (d1, d2, d3, d2, d1). The middle character is at index i, with pair (d1, d2) on the left and (d2, d1) on the right.

hints.title: Digit Pair Tables
hints.text: Precompute prefix tables pref[i][d1][d2] counting occurrences of ordered digit pair (d1, d2) strictly before index i.

hints.title: Suffix Pair Matching
hints.text: Precompute suffix tables suff[i][d2][d1] counting occurrences of ordered digit pair (d2, d1) strictly after index i.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Pair Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: There are only 100 possible digit pairs (d1, d2). Linear scan updates pair states in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all 5-tuples of indices requires O(n^5) combinatorial search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * 100) space for prefix and suffix pair tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Fixes middle index i and uses precomputed prefix/suffix counts for 2-digit pairs.
